title: Let's Learn English Lesson 37
subtitle: Let's Agree to Disagree
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 37: Let's Agree to Disagree (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, I am from the country and sometimes I miss it. But I really like life in the city! I love the city. Oh, look. Someone lost a bag. Maybe it's theirs. Excuse me. Is this bag yours?
dialogue.zh: 你知道，我来自乡下，有时会想念它。可我真的喜欢城市生活！我爱这座城市。哦，看。有人丢了一个包。也许是他们的。打扰一下。这是你的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Jill
dialogue.en: No. It's not mine. It might be hers.
dialogue.zh: 不是。不是我的。也许是她的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me. Is this bag yours?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下。这是你的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.en: No. It's not mine. It might be his.
dialogue.zh: 不是。不是我的。也许是他的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thank you. Hello. Is this bag yours?
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。你好。这是你的包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Yes, that's mine. These are all my travel things. Thank you, thank you!
dialogue.zh: 是的，那是我的。这些都是我的旅行用品。谢谢，谢谢！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you okay? You seem ... nervous.
dialogue.zh: 你还好吗？你看起来……有点紧张。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Well, this is my first visit to Washington, D.C. I'm from a small town in the country. I feel a little lost.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，这是我第一次来华盛顿特区。我来自乡下的一个小镇。我有点迷路。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am from the country too! And I understand. When I first came here, I felt lost ... all the time.
dialogue.zh: 我也来自乡下！我理解。我刚来这儿时，也总是觉得迷路……一直都是。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: So, do you like living in the country or in the city?
dialogue.zh: 那么，你喜欢住在乡下还是城市？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I like to live in the city.
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢住在城市。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: The city is exciting! It has more culture than the country. There are many museums and restaurants. Every night, there is theater and music. And, there are more jobs. That is why I'm here.
dialogue.zh: 城市很精彩！它比乡下更有文化。有很多博物馆和餐厅。每天晚上都有戏剧和音乐。而且，工作也更多。所以我才来这儿。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: Well, I agree. There is more culture in the city and there might be more jobs. But the country has more nature! It's peaceful and beautiful. There are more trees and mountains. The air is clean. You can go hiking and camping. The city is not beautiful. It's noisy and dirty.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我同意。城市更有文化，工作也许也更多。可乡下有更多自然！它安静又美丽。树和山更多。空气干净。你可以去徒步和露营。城市不美。它又吵又脏。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I disagree. I think all the different buildings are beautiful. And I like to watch all the different people.
dialogue.zh: 我不同意。我觉得各种不同的建筑都很美。而且我喜欢看各种各样的人。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: That's another thing that is different. People in the country are friendly. They always say "hello!" Here, no one says "hello." I think city people are rude.
dialogue.zh: 还有一点不一样。乡下的人很友好。他们总是说“你好！”在这儿，没人说“你好”。我觉得城里人很没礼貌。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, I agree. Country people are friendly. But I don't think city people are rude. I think they're just busy.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我同意。乡下人很友好。可我不觉得城里人没礼貌。我觉得他们只是很忙。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: That's a good point.
dialogue.zh: 说得好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Look at me. I live in the city and I said "hello" to you.
dialogue.zh: 看看我。我住在城市，还跟你说了“你好”。

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: But you are from the country.
dialogue.zh: 可你来自乡下。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I have an idea. Let's say "hello!" to people -- to many people!
dialogue.zh: 我有个主意。我们跟人们说“你好！”——跟很多人说！

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: What? Why?
dialogue.zh: 什么？为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, if we say "hello," maybe they will say "hello" to other people ... Hello!
dialogue.zh: 嗯，如果我们说“你好”，也许他们也会对别人说“你好”……你好！

dialogue.speaker: Phil
dialogue.en: ... and they will say "hello" to more people! That's a great idea! I'm glad you found my bag.
dialogue.zh: ……然后他们会对更多人说“你好”！这主意太好了！很高兴你找到了我的包。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come on. Let's go say "hello" to people.
dialogue.zh: 来吧。我们去跟人们说“你好”。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We don't have to agree with people. They have their opinions. We have ours. And as we like to say, you can always agree to disagree! Until next time...! Hello!
dialogue.zh: 我们不必同意别人。他们有他们的看法。我们有我们的。就像我们常说的，你可以求同存异！下次见……！你好！

quiz.prompt: What does Phil like about the country?
What do Anna and Phil decide to say to people?
